scenario: LTIM.6.5 / [LTIM.6.3] / [LTIM.6.4]: every component of `t.utc`, at five boundaries. One rule per boundary requires all seven components (year, month, day, hour, minute, second, day_of_week) to equal that boundary's, and logs its label; one Event at each instant: 2023-12-31T23:59:59Z (a year end, a Sunday: 6); 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z (midnight, a Monday: 0, the ISO origin); 2024-02-29T12:30:45Z (a leap day, a Thursday: 3); 2024-03-01T00:00:00Z (the month end after a leap day, a Friday: 4); and 1969-12-31T23:59:59Z, one second before the epoch, where every component floors (a Wednesday: 2). Exactly the five labels in order: a runtime that gets any component wrong at an instant loses that label -- truncating instead of flooring loses `pre_epoch`, and counting day_of_week from Sunday loses all five. Drives libds's time_component and Mercury's component_at through FN_YEAR .. FN_DAY_OF_WEEK.
rules_ds:
schema Event scope logical:
    id: Int key
    seen: Time mutable

rule year_end:
    Event e where e.seen.utc.year == 2023 and e.seen.utc.month == 12 and e.seen.utc.day == 31 and e.seen.utc.hour == 23 and e.seen.utc.minute == 59 and e.seen.utc.second == 59 and e.seen.utc.day_of_week == 6
->
    log critical "year_end"

rule monday_midnight:
    Event e where e.seen.utc.year == 2024 and e.seen.utc.month == 1 and e.seen.utc.day == 1 and e.seen.utc.hour == 0 and e.seen.utc.minute == 0 and e.seen.utc.second == 0 and e.seen.utc.day_of_week == 0
->
    log critical "monday_midnight"

rule leap_day:
    Event e where e.seen.utc.year == 2024 and e.seen.utc.month == 2 and e.seen.utc.day == 29 and e.seen.utc.hour == 12 and e.seen.utc.minute == 30 and e.seen.utc.second == 45 and e.seen.utc.day_of_week == 3
->
    log critical "leap_day"

rule after_leap:
    Event e where e.seen.utc.year == 2024 and e.seen.utc.month == 3 and e.seen.utc.day == 1 and e.seen.utc.hour == 0 and e.seen.utc.minute == 0 and e.seen.utc.second == 0 and e.seen.utc.day_of_week == 4
->
    log critical "after_leap"

rule pre_epoch:
    Event e where e.seen.utc.year == 1969 and e.seen.utc.month == 12 and e.seen.utc.day == 31 and e.seen.utc.hour == 23 and e.seen.utc.minute == 59 and e.seen.utc.second == 59 and e.seen.utc.day_of_week == 2
->
    log critical "pre_epoch"
